description: Allowed riser counts, riser height, tread run, flights, width, headroom and handrail height for a total rise under Ontario Building Code Part 9.

handrail.description: Handrail height above the nosing line.

location.description: dwelling = within a dwelling unit or house; exitres = exit or public stair, residential building; exitother = exit or public stair, other building.

run.description: Tread run you want (nosing to nosing).

stair_type.description: private = inside or outside a house or single dwelling unit; public = every other stair; service = serves service rooms only (Table 9.8.4.1.).

total_rise.description: Total rise, finished floor to finished floor. At least 375 mm (14.8 in).
